message: Hi, my kid Theo is 9 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! We have Kids Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for ages 5-13, so Theo would be a perfect fit. It's a great program for building confidence and discipline. Is he interested in trying a free trial class?
Yes, a free trial class sounds great! What time do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's your email address?
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Now I just need Theo's full name and date of birth to get him registered for the trial.
Theo's full name is Theo Quartz, and his birthday is March 3, 2017.

Awesome! I have a few times available this week for Theo's free trial:

Wednesday 7/8 at 5:30 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 5:30 PM
Friday 7/10 at 5:30 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Wednesday 7/8 at 5:30 PM. Thank you!
Perfect! Theo is all set for Wednesday, July 8th at 5:30 PM. We're at 10203 Market St Unit E. Just come ready to train and have fun! See you then!
